summary: High demand for modern full-stack web development skills. The district hosts several IT parks and startups actively hiring React and Node.js developers. Cloud skills are increasingly required.
Growing fintech and e-governance sector driving demand for Python, SQL, and Java developers. Machine learning skills are emerging as a key requirement.
Cloud computing and data analytics are the fastest-growing skill areas. Multiple companies are setting up analytics centres, driving demand for Power BI and AWS skills.
India's tech capital continues to demand advanced skills. Machine learning, DevOps and full-stack skills are at peak demand. Highly competitive market.
Strong demand for Java enterprise development and cloud architecture. The HITEC City cluster requires advanced cloud and DevOps skills.
